plain: The story is that James Forrestal, the first US Secretary of Defense, did not take his own life in 1949 but was killed, some say over what he knew about UFOs. In May 1949 he fell from a high window at the Navy hospital in Bethesda, Maryland. Michels tells it himself, saying Forrestal ended up in that hospital and 'gets killed by gravity, quote unquote.' In another episode he adds that 'they found his bathrobe tied to the radiator' before he went out the window. The researcher Richard Dolan, who writes about the history of UFO secrecy, goes further on a show about the case: 'He was absolutely murdered.' Dolan dates the fall to the night of May 21 into 22 and puts it on the 16th floor, mockingly calling it a 'bungee jump.' He draws on Forrestal's own diaries and on figures around him: his brother Henry Forrestal, the defense official Robert Lovett, and a priest, Father Sheehy. If true, a top US official would have been silenced at the very start of the UFO era.
